summary: Recorded the final receipt (2ba5ed477d854a01adbca361e9a8a918, fixed experiment 1479f8725fce4b139838cfa202f7a2a1-experiment, TestAssuranceEPaxosRecoverySameBallotOrder, exit 0, 42 events, no diagnostics), which completes the permutation space of the three-reply tie set that the earlier receipt left half open. The three added orders behave exactly as the trigger position predicts: 2,3,4 and 4,3,2 put an empty reply at the slow-quorum trigger and drop the owner's command (comparisons 0 and 2 violated with complete witnesses 27 and 41), while 4,2,3 puts the command-carrying reply there after an empty first delivery and keeps it (comparison 1 holds, evaluated 34). With the earlier three orders, the full space is consistent - 2,4,3 / 3,4,2 / 2,3,4 / 4,3,2 lose, 3,2,4 / 4,2,3 keep - so no order of this reply set contradicts the measured rule that the reply adopted at the trigger position decides. The update appends this receipt and its consequence to the current interpretation for question 0757162a (plus counterevidence that the completed space is one reply set in one configuration, and a limitation stating that all six tie permutations and four four-reply orders are measured with the trigger observed rather than derived), adds the receipt to the citations of knowledge entry 2b0dd5bd and of the recovery-value family fact bb3ff1d8, and restates the question's discriminator around the one axis still unmeasured: a reply set whose value ballots differ, or enough post-trigger replies to re-reach SlowQuorumSize on the fresh bookkeeping, neither of which this configuration can produce. Validation: valid, no execution requested; effects are the two knowledge citation updates, the question update and the interpretation append. The run's six registered questions all carry explained dispositions, with the recovery-value handling defects asserted on executed receipts and the client-completion and wrong-row-write findings left holding and refuted respectively.
